name: LLMule — Model cards
description: One row per nick/model: what the person who shares it says about it (title, description, hardware) plus what the network measured (answers, tokens, time → tok/s) and the likes. The card outlives the provider process: an offline model keeps its page. Stats rows are created on the first answer; title/description stay empty until the owner writes them.

ownerId.description: mule_users row of whoever shares it

model.description: Public model name, as the provider announces it

description.description: Markdown, written by the owner. Rendered sanitized, images as links

tokSum.description: completion_tokens of answers with a measured time
